title: Maniesh Paul's Mother Passes Away at 77
summary: Maniesh Paul's mother, Urmila Paul, has passed away at the age of 77. Maniesh Paul was a popular Indian television host and actor who was known for his humor and wit. His mother's death has sent shockwaves through the entertainment industry, with many paying tribute to her on social media.
